title: Introducing Mahesh Gaitonde, Chief Digital Officer
excerpt: O3 has named Mahesh Gaitonde as our new Chief Digital Officer.

featuredImage.alt: Mahesh Gaitonde enlightening the O3 team with a presentation.

children.text: A new CDO to help shape the future of technology for O3

O3 has named Mahesh Gaitonde as our new Chief Digital Officer. Formerly of LiquidHub and Capgemini, Mahesh has 20+ years of experience working with digital products and solutions. For our clients, this announcement means they can expect a broader range of innovative products, services and capabilities from O3.
Read the full press release including more on Mahesh’s background and expertise.

seo.description: O3 names Mahesh Gaitonde new Chief Digital Officer to broaden the range of innovative products, services and capabilities coming from O3.
